meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个 AI 互相挑刺,把计划打磨到经得起质疑再定稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在动手前想把方案交给多方挑刺、避免漏判错判
copy.tagline_en: Have multiple AIs critique your plan from opposing angles before you commit
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a plan stress-tested by opposing viewpoints before you commit

howto.what: Claude 会先喊出「HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!」,然后作为 Lead 带领 5 名互相敌对的成员交叉批判你的计划,只留下扛住攻击的见解,再交给专属 planner 写成正式计划。
howto.when: 当规划需要最高严谨度,或你要求做 hyperplan、对抗式、交叉批判式的计划时接管。

say.text: 帮我用 hyperplan 做一份对抗式规划:目标是【X】
say.note: 5 名成员先互相批判,再由 planner 定稿。

say.text: 用交叉批判方式规划【X】,尽量暴露漏洞
say.note: 攻击后只保留经得起批判的见解。

say.text: 对【X】发起 hyperplan,让成员互相攻击彼此结论
say.note: 团队是敌对的,不追求共识。

howto.what_en: Claude announces "HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!", leads 5 mutually hostile members who cross-critique your plan, keeps only the defensible insights, then hands them to a dedicated planner to formalize.
howto.when_en: Triggers when planning needs maximum rigor, or when you ask for a hyperplan, adversarial, or cross-critique plan.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to make an adversarial plan for 【X】
say_en.note: Five hostile members critique first, then a planner formalizes.

say_en.text: Cross-critique plan for 【X】, expose weak spots
say_en.note: Only insights that survive the attacks remain.

say_en.text: Run hyperplan on 【X】, let members attack each other
say_en.note: The team is hostile, not consensus-seeking.
